annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 90 ("The Burial of HCE"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. During this Age of Gods (transition) phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net

annotations.annotation_text: Fall/resurrection motif "wall" on page 90 ("The Burial of HCE"): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattering from the wall, Adam falling in Eden — all converge within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. The comic-cosmic Fall during the Age of Gods (transition) phase demands its counterpart: resurrection through the whiskey-splash of the water of life (uisce beatha).
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Opie, Iona and Peter. The Oxford Dictionary of Nursery Rhymes. https://archive.org/details/oxforddictionary0000unse_m4u1

annotations.annotation_text: Polysyllabic thunderclap on page 90 ("The Burial of HCE"): one of ten 100-letter words synthesizing thunder across world languages, signaling a Viconian cataclysm within the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history. This divine acoustic blast — fusing Hindi, Greek, Latin, French, Italian, Irish, and Norse roots — marks a civilizational transition in the Age of Gods (transition) phase.
sources: Vico, Giambattista. Scienza Nuova (On the Thunder). https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
